mapper.select: SELECT questionSort, questionType, questionName FROM t_questionnaire t, JSON_TABLE( t.questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionSort', questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName')) AS jt WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 and t.id = #{id} AND jt.questionSort = #{answerSort}

SELECT questionSort, questionType, questionName FROM t_questionnaire t, JSON_TABLE( t.questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionSort', questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName' )) AS jt WHERE t.is_deleted and t.id = #{id} AND jt.questionSort = #{answerSort} AND jt.questionType IN ('SINGLE_OPTION')

SELECT answerSort, scale FROM t_questionnaire_data tq, JSON_TABLE( qa_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( answerSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.answerSort', scale JSON PATH '$.scale' )) AS jt WHERE tq.is_deleted = 0 and groups_id = #{groupId} AND questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} AND scale IS NOT NULL ORDER BY answerSort

SELECT questionSort, questionType, questionName FROM t_questionnaire t, JSON_TABLE( t.questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionSort', questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName' )) AS jt WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 and t.id = #{id} AND jt.questionSort = #{answerSort} AND jt.questionType IN ('MEASUREMENT')

SELECT questionSort, choices, scales FROM t_questionnaire t, JSON_TABLE ( t.questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionSort', choices JSON PATH '$.choices', scales JSON PATH '$.scales' )) AS jt WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 and t.id = #{id} AND jt.questionSort = #{answerSort}

SELECT distinct jt.id FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( id LONG PATH '$.config.questionnaireId', elementId varchar(255) PATH '$.id', type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type' )) AS jt WHERE tg.is_deleted = 0 and jt.type = 'collection' AND tg.id = #{groupId}

SELECT jt.questionSort FROM t_questionnaire tq, JSON_TABLE ( questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionSort' )) AS jt WHERE tq.id = #{questionnaireId}

SELECT jt.questionnaireId, jt.id FROM t_groups tg, JSON_TABLE ( process_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( id VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.id', type VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.type', questionnaireId LONG PATH '$.config.questionnaireId' )) AS jt WHERE tg.id = #{groupId} AND jt.type = 'collection'

SELECT jt.questionName, jt.questionType, jt.questionSort FROM `t_questionnaire` tq, JSON_TABLE ( questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionSort LONG PATH '$.questionSort', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName' )) AS jt WHERE tq.id = #{questionnaireId} AND jt.questionType = 'SINGLE_OPTION'

SELECT questionSort, questionType, questionName, choices FROM t_questionnaire t, JSON_TABLE( t.questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionSort', questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName' ,choices JSON PATH '$.choices')) AS jt WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 and t.id = #{id} AND jt.questionSort = #{answerSort}

SELECT jt.questionName, jt.questionType, jt.questionSort FROM `t_questionnaire` tq, JSON_TABLE( questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType', questionSort LONG PATH '$.questionSort', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName')) AS jt WHERE tq.id = #{questionnaireId} and tq.is_deleted = 0
AND jt.questionType = 'MULTI_OPTION'

SELECT jt.questionName, jt.questionSort, jt.questionType FROM t_questionnaire tq, JSON_TABLE( questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort LONG PATH '$.questionSort', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName', questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType' )) AS jt WHERE tq.is_deleted = 0 AND tq.id = #{questionnaireId} AND (jt.questionType = 'SHORT_ANSWER' OR jt.questionType = 'FILL')

SELECT jt.questionName, jt.questionSort, jt.questionType FROM t_questionnaire tq, JSON_TABLE( questionnaire_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( questionSort LONG PATH '$.questionSort', questionName VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionName', questionType VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.questionType' )) AS jt WHERE tq.is_deleted = 0 AND tq.id = #{questionnaireId} AND jt.questionType = 'SORT'
select distinct questionnaire_id from t_questionnaire_data where groups_id = #{groupId} and is_deleted = 0
